SystemFlow.title: How PublishAI Works
SystemFlow.subtitle: Complete pipeline from upload to publication

upload.title: Upload Paper
upload.desc: Upload your raw academic paper in Word or PDF format via drag & drop. The system extracts the text and prepares it for processing.

clarification.title: Clarification Agent
clarification.desc: An AI agent analyzes your paper and identifies the topic, field, and structure. It asks short questions about the target journal requirements.

planning.title: Planning Agent
planning.desc: An advanced AI agent (Opus) reviews the entire paper and creates a detailed revision plan — identifying weaknesses, setting goals, and outlining the workflow.

knowledge.title: Knowledge & References Agent
knowledge.desc: Automatic search across PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and arXiv to find relevant sources, fill in missing references, and update the bibliography.

review.title: Scientific Review Agent
review.desc: Internal peer review — the agent identifies logical flaws, methodological issues, data contradictions, and suggests evidence-based improvements.

writing.title: Academic Writing Agent
writing.desc: Professional rewriting in precise academic language, removal of AI markers, adaptation to the target journal's style, while preserving the author's voice.

execution.title: Execution Agent
execution.desc: Physical implementation of all changes in the text — the agent applies all corrections and edits in Track Changes format so you can approve each change.

qa.title: Quality Assurance Agent
qa.desc: Final check for consistency, spelling and grammar errors, table and figure references, correct numbering, and compliance with journal format.

verification.title: Verification Agent
verification.desc: Generates a simulated peer review report and a professional cover letter for journal submission.

compilation.title: Compilation Agent
compilation.desc: Merges all changes back into the original file format (Word/PDF) while fully preserving formatting, fonts, page numbers, and headers.

export.title: Export & Publish
export.desc: Download the finalized paper in Word/PDF format, along with a cover letter, simulated review report, and a summary of all changes made.
